body: 2026-09-24. cobra for the command tree; voltkit appdir (config location), output (--json envelope) and versioncmd (`agx version`); volt for CI/release. Why: voltkit is the owner's standard kit for Go CLIs and agx grows many subcommands; consistent --json and version provenance with every other voltkit CLI. Consequence: agx was the first external consumer and surfaced the versioncmd output@v0.0.0 packaging bug. Since 8b8877a (2026-10-13) the import path is github.com/ubgo/voltkit/...
title: AGX-001: build on voltkit + cobra
